subject: Evaluation MAP & acceptance ladder — Medsys pilot
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Price <emma.price@medsys.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 2 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation MAP & acceptance ladder — Medsys pilot

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that outlines the evaluation timeline, acceptance tests, and the exit/decision ladder we recommend for the 6-week pilot. High-level goals: reduce inference latency to < 120ms p95 for key flows, keep per-token cost within the projected $0.002/token range, and verify data isolation in the private VPC deployment.

What you'll find inside:
- Week-by-week milestones and owners
- Concrete acceptance tests (functional and load) we will run against the pilot dataset
- Exit gates mapped to pass/fail signals and remediation steps
- Delivery items we need from Medsys to run tests (sample dataset, test accounts, whitelisted IPs)

Action items for this week:
1) Can you confirm owners on your side for the test dataset and security checklist (suggested: Paul for dataset, IT security for whitelisting)?
2) If the acceptance tests look good, we plan to issue an SOW for the Dedicated pilot by next Friday and request a signature via DocuSign.

Attachments: MAP-v1.pdf, acceptance-test-matrix.xlsx, SOW-Medsys-Redwood-v1.docx

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min call if you want to walk through the ladder step-by-step.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Emma Price <emma.price@medsys.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Paul Reynolds <paul.reynolds@medsys.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 11:36:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Evaluation MAP & acceptance ladder — Medsys pilot

Diego —

Thanks for sending this through. Quick read looks good and the level of specificity on the tests is very helpful. A few clarifying items from our side before we lock the calendar: 

- Dataset owner: I will own providing the anonymized pilot sample, but want Paul copied for the schema questions and to sign off on PHI handling.
- Security: Our infra team needs an itemized list of required IPs and ports; can you provide that as a short checklist?
- Decision ladder: we like the idea of clearly-defined exit gates, but can you translate the pass/fail signals into expected decision outcomes (e.g., proceed to paid Dedicated, extend pilot with remediation, or halt)? A single-page quick reference would be perfect.

We're broadly aligned on the timeline. We can target acceptance testing to start the week of May 18th if we get dataset and whitelist access by May 12th.

I'll loop in our procurement person once we have the SOW ready. Could you also include an expected SLA for availability during the pilot window?

Emma
Sr. Product Manager — Medsys Health

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Price <emma.price@medsys.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation MAP & acceptance ladder — Medsys pilot

Emma / team —

Great questions — attaching an updated one-page Decision Ladder and a security checklist for the whitelist. See inline answers below: 

- Dataset/schema: noted that Emma will provide anonymized sample; Paul — please confirm schema compatibility by May 8.
- Security checklist: attachment includes required CIDR ranges, ports (443, 22 for support tunnel), and JWK endpoints if using OIDC.
- Decision outcomes (quick reference):
  * Green: All acceptance tests pass within thresholds — recommend proceed to Dedicated contract (template SOW attached).
  * Amber: Functional tests pass but performance regressions >10% — offer 2-week remediation sprint, run partial re-test, then re-evaluate.
  * Red: Critical functional failures (incorrect reranking or data leakage) — halt rollout, apply corrective patch and re-evaluate with test harness.

Attachments: MAP-v1.pdf (updated with ladder), acceptance-test-matrix.xlsx (row updated), security-whitelist-checklist.txt

Marcus — please prepare the test harness and assign an SRE for the May 18–21 test window. Hannah — can you own the internal go/no-go call on May 22?

Thanks,
Lauren
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Price <emma.price@medsys.com>
Cc: Paul Reynolds <paul.reynolds@medsys.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 7 May 2026 10:27:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Evaluation MAP & acceptance ladder — Medsys pilot

Forwarding the updated MAP and SOW with timeline and signature link. Please see the condensed decision ladder below (we added concrete numeric thresholds):

Decision ladder (condensed):
- Acceptance criteria (GREEN): p95 latency <= 120ms, answer accuracy >= 92% on the sampled QA set, no PII leakage in 1000 randomized probes, error rate < 0.5% during 30-min sustained runs at expected QPS.
- Remediation (AMBER): latency between 120–160ms or accuracy 88–91% — allow one remediation sprint (1–2 weeks) and re-run full acceptance tests.
- Fail (RED): accuracy < 88% or evidence of data leakage or >2% error rate — halt and prioritize fix; no progression to Dedicated until proven.

SOW and signature: https://app.docusign.com/documents/ABC123-SOW
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAPdocs

Attachments referenced: MAP-v1.pdf, acceptance-test-matrix.xlsx, SOW-Medsys-Redwood-v1.docx

Diego

Diego / Lauren —

This looks good to us. We reviewed the decision ladder and numeric thresholds internally — green / amber / red definitions are acceptable. Paul confirmed schema compatibility today (thanks Paul).

Next steps from Medsys:
- I will provide the anonymized pilot dataset by May 11th.
- Our infra team will complete the whitelist by May 12th.
- Procurement will review the SOW and route for signature; please expect a DocuSign request next week.

Please keep the test harness schedule fixed for May 18–21; Hannah — let us know if you need additional info from our side.

Emma
Sr. Product Manager — Medsys Health
